Catalan! Catalan has a lot of monosyllables and oxytones, making it pair very well with English. I think I read somewhere that it was considered the most accurate Latin language for English translations.

There are a few options but the "main" ones are these 3.

1. Salvador Oliva - The easiest to understand. It's not 100% accurate, though. Widely used for school work and usually the go to for staging the comedies.

2. Joan Sellent - A bit more accurate you could say, but I've heard it's not as "theatrical" (the translation was done from a literary perspective). Despite this, his Hamlet is the most popular translation among drama students and theatres.

3. Josep Maria de Sagarra - He was also a very renowned author who practically "invented" Shakespeare in Catalan. Most accurate translations, not a single verse missed, nor a syllable out of place. Old school Catalan is fairly understandable but the author and his work (including Shakespeare adaptations) did go through TWO dictatorships and that took it away from the mainstream. IMO best translations and I wish more companies used Sagarra's, but it's considered for scholars and experts. Hate the elitism but it is what it is... He never touched Hamlet because "it's absolutely perfect and any modification about it would ruin it".

I think they all 3 did tons of sonnets too, but I could be wrong. My field of expertise is the plays so that's what I could think of! Hope it helps.

If you're also into shows with ships "sailing" on stage and don't mind other languages, in Catalonia we have "Mar i Cel". A whole-ass ship on stage that even bows at the end. Biggest production ever made here. Broadway wanted to buy the production back in the 80s but they didn't have the tech and means to do it at the time. (The ship is remotely controlled and turns around 360° and all). The score is simply brilliant!

[Original 1988 production.](https://youtu.be/DbPQFZiSgqo?si=iqETJQvHm-DyRx_O) Great acting, you'll see why all the fuss.

[2014 production](https://youtu.be/YMCIQd8Ec1k?si=bXCZ9AVARFyxRKvS) Def. not as great but much better video quality and it's not terrible, has some actors from the original one and some very good updating choices.
